architecture: Existing full_joint local four-spin Schur + balanced inter-cell CG decoder. Full local q=0,2,4, no intermediate-q truncation, layer-shared free reduced tensors. Two independent real decoders form Re+i Im; doubled counts reported. No ViT or new attention mechanism. Same 2x2-coordinate cells for both lattices; triangular cells are rhombi, not triangles.
initialization: Teachers 01/02 use decoder seeds 2026093001/02 respectively on both lattices and both widths. One initialization per teacher-width, no restarts or outcome selection. Two real components use split PRNG keys.
symmetry: SU2 comes from the physical CG contractions, not P0. Gamma-A1 imposed by exact orbit sums at every objective evaluation. Full-support N16 sums are a diagnostic acceleration, not a scalable spatial-projection claim.
objectives: First 1-|<teacher|decoder>|^2, with teacher projected_terminal loaded from the sealed VAP physical states. Then physical E_H, reset optimizer moments, same decoder and all weights train. No teacher amplitude is added to the output. Report every initial/fit/energy state, even if fitting fails.
budget: 8 trials, each at most 256 fitting and 128 energy attempts and 240 active seconds. Total at most32 active CPU minutes plus preparation/tests. No adaptive widening or longer fits. No new ED, N36 training, GPU or remote work.
interpretation: Fitting fidelity is teacher compression, not ground-state discovery. A residual fit error under this budget does not prove a representational lower bound. Energy refinement can exceed teacher fidelity/energy in different directions; energy and variance must be reported separately. Counts are stored real scalars, not tangent ranks; comparison to ViT is not matched-work or a scaling claim.
diagnostics: Initial raw and projected S2/A1/H replay, finite-difference fit/energy gradients, tangent singlet residual; checkpoint replay; physical energy/variance, overlap and cuts at initial/fit/final. Every 32 attempts retain energy, variance and teacher infidelity. At initial and fit state use 2*singlet_A1_dimension+4 deterministic Gaussian parameter directions (seed0), exact JVPs and gauge-orthogonal real/imag SVD; report rank lower bounds at relative 1e-6/1e-8/1e-10, with singular values and measured diagnostic time, not a global capacity proof.
